info.title: Web3 Autonomous Scraper API
info.description: Bypasses CAPTCHAs and returns clean HTML from any URL. Costs 0.005 USDC per scrape. Pay via x402 on Solana — no account required.

post.description: x402 v2 payment-gated endpoint. On first call returns 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 x402 v2 challenge) and accepts[] array. Pay 0.005 USDC on Solana mainnet (network: solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp) then retry with X-PAYMENT header containing base64-encoded payment proof.

parameters.name: X-PAYMENT
parameters.description: x402 v2 payment proof. Base64-encoded JSON containing {x402Version:2, scheme:'exact', network:'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp', payload:{signature:'<tx_sig>'}}. Omit on the first request to receive the payment challenge. The transaction must be less than 5 minutes old and can only be used once.

parameters.name: Payment-Payload
parameters.description: Legacy v0 header — raw Solana transaction signature. Accepted for backward compatibility. Prefer X-PAYMENT for x402 v2 agents.

targetUrl.description: The full URL of the page to scrape.

data.description: Scraped HTML content of the target URL

400.description: Payment verification failed. Distinct from a malformed request — the request body was valid but the Payment-Payload signature was rejected. Check the error string: 'already used' = replay attempt, 'too old' = expired (>5 min), 'Insufficient payment' = underpayment, 'not found' = invalid signature.

value.error: This payment receipt has already been used.
Transaction is too old. Payments must be made within the last 5 minutes.
Insufficient payment. Expected 0.005 USDC, but received 0 USDC.
Transaction not found on the blockchain.

402.description: Payment Required — x402 v2 challenge. Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 decode for full challenge), pay 0.005 USDC on Solana mainnet, then retry with X-PAYMENT header.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 challenge JSON containing x402Version, resource, and accepts[] array.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Legacy x402 v0 challenge for backward compatibility.
